subject: CipherCorp SIG: Clarifications & evidence handoff plan
messages:
From: Linda Young <linda.young@ciphercorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG Questionnaire clarifications and evidence timeline request

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. CipherCorp reviewed Redwood's SIG submission and we have a few clarifying asks before procurement will move to final PO. I've attached the completed questionnaire with inline notes (CipherCorp_SIG_Questionnaire_20271018.xlsx). High-level items we need: 

- Confirm our interpretation of the "Key Management" control: do you manage keys in customer tenants or via a third-party KMS? We need proof of rotation and split-knowledge procedures.
- Provide sample audit records for privileged access changes (last 90 days).
- The procurement team needs the latest SOC 2 report and the scope (any subservice orgs included).
- Clarify retention and log aggregation: which S3 buckets or logging endpoints will hold production telemetry? We need evidence of bucket policies and access controls.

Target timeline from our side: evidence package delivered by Friday, Nov 3 so legal can review for November 10 approval. If you cannot meet that, propose an alternative schedule. Also flag any artifacts that must be redacted for customer data.

Can you confirm owners and send a short list of attachments we should expect? Happy to set a follow-up call if helpful.

Procurement (procurement@ciphercorp.com) is looped for scheduling and PO questions.

Thanks,
Linda Young
Senior Security & Procurement
CipherCorp

Attachment: CipherCorp_SIG_Questionnaire_20271018.xlsx (xlsx, 1.2MB)

I attached a control-mapping draft that I started (redwood_control_map_draft.xlsx). If we can give them a clear list by EOD tomorrow, I think we should hit Nov 3.

Thanks — V.

Vanessa / Marissa — I can take point on the mapping and the artifact manifest. Initial notes below (will attach files once I've pulled the exports):

1) Key Management (KMS)
- Redwood uses customer-dedicated KMS integration for Private deployments and our hosted product uses a managed HSM with strict separation. For CipherCorp scope (hosted API use), evidence we can provide: SOC2 description of KMS controls, a snapshot of rotation schedule (kms_rotation_log_excerpt.csv), and HSM vendor attestation.
- Owner: Security/Infra (Marissa to confirm redaction).

2) Privileged access and audit logs
- We will provide a 7-14 day excerpt of privileged user change events from the identity provider (time-stamped audit lines), redacted for PII. Format: CSV with username (redacted), action, timestamp, requestor id.
- Owner: Infra; expected filename: privileged_audit_excerpt_20271014-20271018.csv.

3) SOC 2 report
- We will share SOC 2 Type II FY2026 PDF with a non-disclosure watermark. Confirmed available: soc2-report-2026.pdf.

4) S3 / logging retention and bucket policy
- Provide bucket policy JSON snippets and an S3 inventory manifest. We will not share full production telemetry; instead we will provide policy and a sample object ACL screenshot (kms_proof_snapshot.png).

Proposed artifact manifest (deliverables to CipherCorp):
- soc2-report-2026.pdf
- kms_rotation_log_excerpt.csv
- privileged_audit_excerpt_20271014-20271018.csv
- s3_bucket_policy_example.json (snippet)
- evidence_manifest_v1.txt (index of artifacts and redaction notes)

Timeline:
- Internal packaging complete by Mon, Oct 25 (we'll upload to a secure S3 folder and generate pre-signed links).
- Deliver to CipherCorp by Tue, Oct 26 for their review; final by Nov 3 if they request changes.

Questions for Marissa: any controls you think require Legal+Security review before exposure? Also confirm whether we should include vendor attestation from our HSM vendor.

I'll attach the initial CSV and SOC2 stub in a follow-up mail.

Thanks — Karthik

Attachment (pending): kms_rotation_log_excerpt.csv, soc2-report-2026.pdf
